title: When speaking feels unsafe
odia: କହିବି ତା ଆଗେ ଶୁଣିବେ କେ? ଘଇତା ଅବୁଝା ମାରିବ ଯେ
literal_meaning: I would tell him—but who will listen? The uncomprehending husband will hit me.
explanation: The speaker fears that a complaint will bring violence instead of a hearing. The saying exposes a situation in which someone feels unheard and unsafe; it does not make that treatment acceptable.
meaning_odia: ମନର କଥା କହିଲେ ଶୁଣାଯିବା ବଦଳରେ ମାଡ଼ ମିଳିବ ବୋଲି ବକ୍ତା ଭୟ କରୁଛନ୍ତି। ଯାହାଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ନେଇଯିବା କଥା, ସେହିଠାରେ ଅସୁରକ୍ଷା ଅନୁଭବ ହେଉଛି। ଏହି କଥା ନିରୁପାୟ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଦେଖାଏ; ଘରୋଇ ହିଂସାକୁ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ବା ଗ୍ରହଣଯୋଗ୍ୟ କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: In a fictional discussion, this line names the fear of being punished for speaking up. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ଘଇତା means husband here. The gendered scene belongs to this witness, not a claim about all husbands or households.
